description: An official document certifying the annual income of an individual or family, issued by the Revenue Department.
purpose: Required to apply for scholarships, educational admission concessions, government subsidies, and welfare schemes.
target_users: Any resident of Tamil Nadu requiring income certification.
eligibility: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu

description: An official document certifying the community/caste category of an individual.
purpose: Essential to obtain reservation benefits in education admissions and government jobs in Tamil Nadu.
target_users: Residents belonging to recognized caste categories (SC, ST, BC, MBC, DNC).
eligibility: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu
Must belong to a recognized community category

description: Certifies that a person is a native/domicile of Tamil Nadu.
purpose: Mandated for educational admissions (especially counseling processes like TNEA) and state government recruitment.
target_users: Individuals who are born in or have domicile in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility: Must be a native of Tamil Nadu or residing for a continuous specified period (usually 5+ years)
required_documents: School TC showing place of study

description: Application to obtain a new Public Distribution System (PDS) smart card for a family.
purpose: Enables the purchase of subsidized food grains and serves as a vital identity and address proof.
target_users: Families residing in Tamil Nadu without an existing ration card.
eligibility: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu
Must not hold a ration card in any other state / family card already
required_documents: Aadhaar Cards of all family members
Name Deletion Certificate from previous family card (if moving out)
optional_documents: Gas Connection Bill / LPG Consumer Card
application_channel: e-Sevai Portal / Assisted Center / TNPDS Portal

description: Certifies that the applicant is the first person in their family to pursue graduation.
purpose: Aims to help students from non-educated families secure fee concessions in engineering, medical and other professional college counseling.
target_users: Students whose parents and siblings are not graduates.
eligibility: Applicant must be a native of Tamil Nadu
No other family member (parents or siblings) should be a graduate
required_documents: School TC / Provisional Certificate of applicant
Declaration signed by parents and candidate
TCs or highest education certificates of all family members
